•Render Sandboxes ↗ — A computer for every agent

Render Sandboxes hands every agent its own Linux box, up and running in under a second, which will take Claude Code or Codex or whatever harness you're on. The agent can bring your actual app up with Docker Compose and test its own changes against it, and you pick which domains that box is allowed to reach. Best bit: when the agent stops doing anything the sandbox suspends and the meter stops, then wakes later with the files and memory exactly where they were. You can run thousands at once, on the same platform the rest of your app already sits on.

Glasshand rents your agent a real iPhone. Not a simulator, an actual phone sitting in a rack in their data centre, which Claude Code or Codex can pick up with one prompt and then use exactly like you would: posting on TikTok, booking an Uber, building an iOS app and testing it on the same hardware your users are holding.
